description: This file defines a PHP class for interacting with the AWS WAFV2 service, providing methods to manage web ACLs, IP sets, rule groups, and other related resources through AWS SDK.

classes.name: WAFV2Client
classes.description: A client class used to perform operations on AWS WAFV2 service, extending AwsClient to inherit common client functionality.

methods.description: Associates a Web ACL with a resource.
